validation_rules: all graph-required producers have a newest accepted common envelope or an edge-authorized SKIPPED envelope
terminal instance, accepted pointer, envelope, artifact and permission-receipt hashes are revalidated before publication
every producer binds the same run and source snapshot and all non-null build lineage hashes are compatible
missing, failed, blocked, canceled, stale, corrupt, duplicate, mixed-generation or unclaimed terminal inputs prevent complete publication
coverage gaps and authorized skips remain explicit and are never described as successful coverage
producer artifacts are copied into the immutable assembly attempt and retain producer job, attempt, path and hash identity
manifest_sha256 binds every other intel-manifest field; the common envelope and accepted pointer bind the manifest bytes
